homeText: Comprehensive reference for BetterHelper Framework: routing, SSR, islands, JSX runtime, and CLI.
aboutText: This docs site is built on BetterHelper itself, without React.
docsHomeText: Pick a section to start. Fundamentals are recommended for first-time users.
heroSubtitle: A lightweight TypeScript framework with built-in SSR, file-based routing, and a custom JSX runtime. No React required.
featureSsrDesc: Out-of-the-box SSR with React-like hydration modes (Full, Islands, None).
featureJsxDesc: Write JSX and use hooks without shipping React or Preact to your users.
featureRouterDesc: Intuitive folder structure handles static, dynamic, and catch-all routes.
